module: Junos® OS Evolved Juniper Express 5 MACsec Cryptographic Module Version 1.0
caveat: When operated with module Junos® OS Evolved OpenSSL Cryptographic Module version 3.0 validated to FIPS 140-3 under Cert. #5412 operating in approved mode, and module Junos® OS Evolved Kernel Cryptographic Module version 2.1 validated to FIPS 140-3 under Cert. #5470, operating in approved mode.
description: Junos® OS Evolved Juniper Express 5 MACsec Cryptographic Module Version 1.0 is composed of the Juniper Express 5 MACsec blocks that are part of the Juniper Networks® Express 5 processor in hardware, which provides AES GCM and XPN algorithm implementations for encrypting and decrypting MACsec traffic, and a device driver in software, which provides the functionality to comply with FIPS 140-3 requirements i.e. integrity test, self-tests), as well as the API to configure the hardware component.
